context: Tests whether the agent creates an ADR with correct sequence numbering based on existing records, uses investigation prompts for unknown information, includes References and Reversibility sections when warranted, and produces research notes proving codebase exploration occurred.

checklist.name: Correct sequence number
checklist.description: New ADR filename uses sequence number 0002 (next after existing 0001), zero-padded to 4 digits

checklist.name: Filename slug format
checklist.description: ADR filename has a lowercase, hyphenated slug describing the state management decision (e.g. 0002-use-zustand-for-state-management.md)

checklist.name: YAML frontmatter complete
checklist.description: YAML frontmatter contains status, date, and authors fields

checklist.name: Status is PROPOSED
checklist.description: The status field in YAML frontmatter is PROPOSED

checklist.name: Investigation prompts used
checklist.description: At least one [INVESTIGATE: ...] prompt is present in the ADR for information that cannot be determined from the project files (e.g. team preference details, performance benchmarks)

checklist.name: References section present
checklist.description: ADR includes a References section with at least one link or cross-reference to related resources or the existing ADR

checklist.name: Reversibility section present
checklist.description: ADR includes a Reversibility section describing conditions that would trigger reconsideration or how to migrate away

checklist.name: Two or more alternatives
checklist.description: Alternatives Considered section contains at least two alternatives, each with pros, cons, and rejection reasons

checklist.name: Active voice decision
checklist.description: Decision section states the choice in active voice (e.g. 'We will adopt...' not 'X was decided')

checklist.name: Consequences split
checklist.description: Consequences section is split into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: ADR contains no unfilled template placeholders (no '[Driver 1]', 'YYYY-MM-DD', '[Alternative 1]', etc.)

checklist.name: research-notes.md present
checklist.description: A research-notes.md file exists at the working directory root describing files examined and patterns found in the codebase
